contact.transcript_note: [sorted identifiers, base64url(MLS epoch_authenticator), heads]; heads are each identity's chain-head hash, in the identifiers' order. Stand-ins: an authenticator of 32 bytes 0x33, and heads of 0x61 and 0x62

description: A contact verification-code round (SPEC §6.7). commitment = SHA-256("tieroute code commit" || r); digest = SHA-256(JCS(["tieroute/v1", "code", "contact", transcript, reveals])), where byte strings are base64url and reveals are sorted by their raw bytes; code = Crockford base32 of the first 5 bytes.
notice: Test vectors for Tieroute v1 (draft). These keys are public: never use them for anything real.
